findings: LRU eviction aborts the tile controller and removes queued work; fetchData receives its signal. This is not proof that merely leaving view aborts immediately.
Three parser checks the abort signal before committing its scene and disposes abandoned texture results.
UnloadTilesPlugin releases GPU resources while retaining CPU model data for re-upload. This is distinct from complete tile disposal.
LRU accounting is estimated and updated as work finishes, not a reservation of all transient browser allocations. Shared cross-tile texture ownership still needs an integration test.
